entities.summary: Leader of Holy See (2013–2025). First Latin American pope (Argentina); first Jesuit pope; first to choose 'Francis' (after St. Francis of Assisi); reformed Vatican finances; Laudato Si' (2015, landmark encyclical on climate change);
